definitions.explanation: Someone who works for a company or office for a salary, as opposed to the self-employed. Slightly old-fashioned.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧ごく⟦{普通|ふつう}→普通：01502_futsuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{勤|つと}め{人|にん}だった。
examples.english: My father was an ordinary salaried worker.

examples.japanese: {勤|つと}め{人|にん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{平日|へいじつ}→平日：03033_heijitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{休|やす}み→休み：02266_yasumi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧にくい。
examples.english: Employees find it hard to take time off on weekdays.

examples.japanese: {勤|つと}め{人|にん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{辞|や}めて⟦{自分|じぶん}→自分：02887_jibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|ひら}く→開く：01979_hiraku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{長年|ながねん}→長年：09684_naganen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{夢|ゆめ}→夢：01519_yume⟧だった。
examples.english: Quitting salaried work to open my own shop had long been my dream.

notes:
⟦{勤|つと}める→勤める：00902_tsutomeru⟧ (to work for) + ⟦{人|にん}→〜人：00658_nin⟧ (person).

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦サラリーマン→サラリーマン：06084_sarariiman⟧: salaried office worker (the everyday word, traditionally for men)
- ⟦{会社員|かいしゃいん}→会社員：03018_kaishain⟧: company employee (neutral; used on forms)
- ⟦{自営業|じえいぎょう}→自営業：15723_jieigyou⟧: self-employed (the contrast)
